title: ResearchHypothesis
description: A testable scientific hypothesis generated during a SciLoop research campaign

campaign_id.description: ID of the parent research campaign

statement.description: The hypothesis statement, phrased as a testable claim

evidence_type.description: Source classification — model_hypothesis (agent reasoning, lowest weight), literature (PubMed-backed, medium weight), computational_prediction (RDKit/scoring, must label as prediction)

confidence.description: Agent's confidence in this hypothesis (0-1). Must decrease when contradictory evidence is found.

parent_hypothesis_id.description: If this hypothesis was derived from refining another

relevance.description: How this evidence relates to the hypothesis
